episodes.synopsis: The students have now finally settled into their new lives, but a new student has come to the school, and his name is… "Shield"?
episodes.title: Join the Fight! Transfer Student

episodes.synopsis: Life's great in this world, except for one thing: there's no alcohol! When the students sneak into the principal's office to get their fix from his stash, they run into more than they bargained for.
episodes.title: Sneak In! The Principal's Office

episodes.synopsis: This new world is a great place: no fighting, no danger, and the classes are easy. But you REALLY don't want to get detention!
episodes.title: Uh-Oh! Detention!

episodes.synopsis: It's time for a test! Everybody expects Ains to score highly, but… he never even passed middle school!
episodes.title: Pinch! Test of Learning

episodes.synopsis: It's Valentine's Day, which means it's time to give chocolate to the boy you like! But an unexpected face makes an appearance…
episodes.title: Work Hard! Valentine's Day

episodes.synopsis: It's time for a battle to settle the most important question of all: what do you put on your chicken wings?
episodes.title: Clash! Dodgeball

episodes.synopsis: It's time for physicals, and everybody's ready to get naked and get on the scale! Who will be brave enough to go peek at the opposite sex?
episodes.title: Excitement! Physicals Day

episodes.synopsis: Visha's been working overtime lately. But what does she need the money for?
episodes.title: Challenge! Part-Time Job

episodes.synopsis: It's time for a play! But what kind of play should they put on? Filo will find out!
episodes.title: Investigate! First Errand

episodes.synopsis: It's time for a school festival! But something is lurking outside the school…
episodes.title: Rise Up! School Festival

episodes.synopsis: The curtain rises on the school festival! There's a special guest, too…
episodes.title: It Begins! School Festival

episodes.synopsis: The mobile fortress "Destroyer" has joined the last game! It's up to the quartet to grab its headband and win the game.
episodes.title: The Show Begins! Showtime
